requirements.description: User wants energy class C or better, so the accepted classes are A1-A4, B and C. The energy_score_class column cannot isolate C (score 3 covers B-E), so energy_class is used.
User explicitly wants a location near public transport. Set at the 75th percentile (70.93, rounded to 71) of the mobility distribution.

A university student residence is inherently tied to universities and schools, so nearby education services are necessary. Set at the 75th percentile (75.14, rounded to 75) of the education distribution.
The user explicitly requires at least 850 sqm of gross floor area. The 60-person capacity is not converted into an area threshold because no verified gross-area threshold per occupant was provided.

output.sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE property_type = 'Uffici e assimilabili' AND surface_area >= 850 AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C') AND mobility >= 71 AND education >= 75 AND haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC
output.explanation: Filters office properties (property_type 'Uffici e assimilabili') with surface_area >= 850, energy_class A1-A4/B/C, mobility >= 71, education >= 75, and within 3.0 km of (45.0677551, 7.6824892). Results ordered by haversine distance. tipologia_bene_immobile is mapped to the filterable property_type column. The 60-person capacity has no matching column and is not applied.
